# sync-directory

> A Node.js package and syncdir CLI for syncing local source and target directories by copy (default) or hardlink, with optional watch mode and path filters.

## Documentation

- [Single-page guide](https://hoperyy.github.io/sync-directory/): install, examples, complete CLI and API reference.
- [Install](https://hoperyy.github.io/sync-directory/#quick-start)

- [Watch mode](https://hoperyy.github.io/sync-directory/#watch-and-filter)
- [Configuration within the API section](https://hoperyy.github.io/sync-directory/#options)

## Package and source

- [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/sync-directory)
- [Repository and README](https://github.com/hoperyy/sync-directory)

## Usage

CLI: npm install --global sync-directory; syncdir <from> <to> [options].
CommonJS: const syncDirectory = require('sync-directory').
ESM: import syncDirectory, { async as syncDirectoryAsync } from 'sync-directory'.

Import from the package root; the exports map does not expose sync-directory/index.mjs.

## Behavior

- Copy is the default; watch is off by default. Source and target are local paths.
- syncDirectory() and syncDirectory.sync() return undefined or a chokidar watcher with watch: true.
- The async API returns a Promise resolving to undefined or the watcher. It awaits initial scan and callbacks; copies still use synchronous filesystem operations.
- skipInitialSync with watch: true processes subsequent changes without initially copying unchanged entries.
- Watch mode propagates source deletions regardless of deleteOrphaned.
- deleteOrphaned controls initial cleanup within the scanned, non-excluded target set; excluded target entries are not reliably removed.
- Strings in exclude/forceSync are substring filters, not globs. Regular expressions, functions and arrays are also supported.
- forceSync wins when both filters are evaluated. In watch mode, chokidar can ignore an ancestor before forceSync runs. Watch handlers also copy newly added directories recursively without filtering each descendant.
- Hardlinks share file data, require the same filesystem, and may not trigger target-side watchers. New or replaced source files are not reliably linked by watch event handlers with stayHardlink: true.
- staySymlink is handled during initial hardlink sync. The CLI --symlink sets supportSymlink, which does not match that implementation option.
- nodeep limits the initial scan; a watched new-directory event can still copy descendants.
- Initial onError callbacks are not awaited; some low-level failures are caught internally.
